title: Forged Educational Qualifications by Employment Pass and S Pass Holders in Infocomm Technology Industry
what_it_is: Forged Educational Qualifications by Employment Pass and S Pass Holders in Infocomm Technology Industry

sections.label: False qualifications by work pass holders
sections.summary: From 2018 to 2020, 11 Employment Pass and S Pass holders in ICT submitted false qualifications to MOM, had passes revoked and were permanently barred.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: From 2018 to 2020, 11 Employment Pass and S Pass holders working in the infocomm technology (ICT) industry were found to have submitted false qualifications to the Ministry of Manpower (MOM).

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Their work passes were revoked and they were permanently barred from working in Singapore.

sections.label: Verification and penalties for false qualifications
sections.summary: MOM requires third-party verification for qualifications from institutions not in its database, rejects fake or unaccredited qualifications, and may revoke passes, debar or prosecute offenders.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: For applications containing qualifications from institutions that are not in our database, we require employers to submit verification proof from third-party screening organisations to ensure that the qualifications submitted are accredited.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: We will reject applications containing fake or unaccredited qualifications.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: Besides revocation of work passes and debarment from employment in Singapore, we may also prosecute offenders for false declaration under the Employment of Foreign Manpower Act, which carries a fine of up to $20,000 or up to two years’ imprisonment, or both.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: At MOM, we use a predictive fraud model and we stratify the academic institutions according to different levels of risk.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: For the highest risk, we require the employers to submit, as I have alluded to earlier on, verification proof from a third-party screening organisation as part of the work pass application process.

sections.label: Checks with accredited universities
sections.summary: MOM conducts independent verification checks with the university concerned from time to time for degrees from accredited universities.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: To the Member's point about those from accredited universities, or even some of them, Ivy League universities, and whether they can fake these degrees, we do have, from time to time, verification, independent checks where we check with the university concerned.
